detail.longDescription: Your AI assistant can put together a road-trip playlist or point you to artists who sound like your favorites. But when the chat closes, so does the help. The song you liked in the car still has to be dropped into the right playlist, your listening history stays locked inside Spotify, and the track you just added to a shared playlist still needs announcing.
